output.title: New metrics for certificate lifecycle monitoring now available
output.content: This change adds certificate issuance and expiration timestamp metrics to cert-manager. The environment shows prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled and targetPort configured, indicating active Prometheus monitoring. The new metrics enable better certificate lifecycle visibility and alerting for expiration tracking. Review your Prometheus scrape configuration to capture the new certmanager_certificate_not_before_timestamp_seconds and certmanager_certificate_not_after_timestamp_seconds metrics.
